title: Joy of Giving at Paypal Office

photo.alt: Joy of Giving at Paypal Office

summary: PayPal, the global fintech company, organized a Joy of Giving initiative today.
description:
PayPal, the global fintech company, organized a Joy of Giving initiative today. Six students from Shri Sai Vidyalaya, Mankhurd, Mumbai accompanied by their Principal and a teacher, received gift hampers personally handed over by PayPal staff.
In addition, over 100 hampers have been delivered to the school for distribution among students actively engaged in environmental protection efforts. The idea was to showcase to students the value of learning and its impact on jobs. Along with Paypal India Country manager, the Paypal staff, Asha Janardhan and Dr Ajay Sati from RCBCW participated in the event.
